datasheet.title: 9g Precision Micro Position Servo Motor with Feedback Potentiometer
datasheet.description: The TowerPro SG90 is the global hobby and robotics standard 9-gram analog micro servo motor. Delivers 1.8 kg·cm stall torque with 180° rotation capability. Includes internal DC motor, gear reduction train, potentiometer feedback, and proportional-integral servo control amplifier circuit.

pinout.name: VCC (Red Lead)
pinout.desc: Motor power supply rail (+4.8V to +6.0V DC)

pinout.name: PWM (Orange / Yellow)
pinout.desc: Standard 50Hz (20ms period) PPM/PWM position control signal pulse (1.0ms - 2.0ms)

datasheet.appNotes: Position angle is controlled by the pulse duration: 1.0ms pulse corresponds to 0° (full left), 1.5ms pulse corresponds to 90° (neutral center), and 2.0ms pulse corresponds to 180° (full right). When powered from MCU, add a 100µF decoupling capacitor to suppress motor surge transients.
